dedupe_keys.name: geodanmark basic topographic data roads paths cycle tracks railways

description: GeoDanmark grunddata is Denmark's shared national topographic base data, maintained by a collaboration between the Agency for Data Supply and Infrastructure (SDFI) and the 98 municipalities to give uniform nationwide mapping of towns and landscape. Objects are captured mainly from aerial photographs, field surveys and drawings from building and road cases. The traffic theme includes road centre lines (Vejmidte) for motorised, pedestrian, cycling and riding traffic, railway, road edges, traffic islands, chicanes and railway stations; road centre lines carry attributes for road or path type, road category (from main route to minor path, cycle path along road and cycle lane along road), traffic type (motorway, pedestrian street, path, footpath, cycle path, bus gate and others), bridge or tunnel level, surface, slip roads and roundabouts. Other themes cover buildings, technical features, nature, hydrography and topography. Coverage is national. Access through Datafordeleren and Dataforsyningen; the specification (version 6.0.2, with 7.0 in consultation in August 2026) is published in Danish. The data are free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: road category is meant mainly for cartography, and some attributes are sparsely filled. The data support national road, cycling and rail network models for network flow and hazard exposure studies, and complement the EuroVelo network catalogued here.
